stem.text: Two types of epithelial cells, 1 and 2, occur in the mammalian gas exchange system in a healthy human.

stem.alt: Line drawing of a flat epithelial cell layer, labelled 1.
Line drawing of a tall epithelial cell layer with cilia on its surface, labelled 2.

stem.text: Which row shows the function and distribution of these types of epithelial cells?

A.text: absorption in bronchi; secrete mucus in alveoli

B.text: exchange surface in alveoli; secrete mucus in bronchi

C.text: absorption in bronchi; move mucus in alveoli

D.text: exchange surface in alveoli; move mucus in bronchi
